final_answer_text:
Here is your daśā, read at every level that is actually running today.

**The four periods you are inside right now**

| Level | Lord | Runs | The lord's own condition at birth |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mahādaśā | **Mercury** | 18 Aug 2010 – 18 Aug 2027 | Capricorn, **10th house**, Uttara Āṣāḍhā, dignity neutral |
| Antardaśā | **Saturn** | 8 Dec 2024 – 18 Aug 2027 | Libra, **7th house**, Viśākhā, **exalted** |
| Pratyantardaśā | **Moon** | 27 Jun 2026 – 17 Sep 2026 | Aquarius, **11th house**, Pūrva Bhādrapadā, neutral |
| Sūkṣma | **Mercury** | 13 – 25 Aug 2026 | Capricorn, 10th house — **flagged as a junction (sandhi) period** |

**The big frame: sixteen years of Mercury, now in its last year.**
Mercury has governed your life since August 2010 and hands over on **18 August 2027** — almost exactly one year from now. Mercury sits in your **10th house**, the house of profession and public standing, which is why this whole stretch has been career-shaped whether or not it felt that way.

But there is a real qualification, and it is the most important thing in this reading. For an Aries ascendant, Mercury rules the 3rd and the 6th, which makes it a **duṣṭhāna lord and a temporal malefic** for you. The system grades your Mercury daśā at **warning tier "elevated."** In plain terms: a long period placed in a strong, visible house, but run by a lord whose functional nature is one of friction, effort, competition, and obstacle-management rather than smooth gain. Sixteen years of grinding forward in the professional sphere rather than being carried.

**The current sub-period: Saturn, and this is the interesting one.**
Since December 2024 you have been in **Saturn's antardaśā**, running to the end of the Mercury cycle. Saturn here is a genuine paradox, and I want to lay both halves out:
- Saturn is **exalted in Libra, in your 7th house**, and it is the **second-strongest graha in your entire chart** (Ṣaḍbala 7.83). By raw capacity, this is a powerful period lord.
- And yet Saturn is *also* a temporal malefic for Aries, and its varga-ratification comes in at **0.8 rather than 1.0** across career, health and wealth — meaning its promise is only partly confirmed in the divisional charts. The system grades it **"elevated"** as well.

A strong graha whose delivery is not fully ratified is a very specific experience: **capability that arrives with conditions attached.** Things do get built in this period, but slowly, with weight, and with terms you did not set. That Saturn sits in your **7th** house means partnership — marital and professional — is the arena where that weight lands.

**Right now, this month.**
Moon's pratyantardaśā runs to **17 September 2026** — Moon is a *functional benefic* for you and the only one of your three period lords carrying **no warning at all**. Within it, you are currently in a **Mercury sūkṣma from 13 to 25 August that is explicitly flagged as a junction period.** Daśā junctions are classically periods of instability and unclear signal — not a time to read too much into how things feel, and not an ideal moment for irreversible decisions. It clears on the 25th.

**What comes next.** Your Mercury Mahādaśā ends 18 August 2027 and Ketu's seven-year period begins. I should tell you that **Ketu is graded "watch" — it is the second-weakest graha in your chart** (Ṣaḍbala percentile 0.13). That is a significant handover and worth preparing for rather than meeting cold.

**On confidence.** This is the most solid answer I can give you of anything you have asked. Every date and every placement here is marked `two_pass_verified` in the source and carries a full computational citation — unlike the predictive material, this is calculation, not forecast. The one caveat is interpretive: the "elevated" warning tiers are a deterministic four-factor score (duṣṭhāna lordship, strength percentile, varga ratification, functional malefic status), published openly and applied identically to every chart. It is a well-defined flag, not a calibrated probability of anything bad happening.

**One thing I noticed and should pass on.** Looking at your period lords surfaced two facts that never appeared when I asked about marriage earlier: **Saturn is exalted in your 7th house**, and **Venus — your 7th lord and the kāraka for marriage — is in the bottom quarter of your chart for strength.** Both bear directly on partnership, and both are more consequential than anything the marriage assessment itself returned to me. If relationships are a live question for you, those two facts are where a real reading would start.
